versions.changelog:
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file to streamline the project structure.
- Updated project deconstruction guidance: replaced the generic process with a detailed six-layer deconstruction framework for systematic analysis of codebases.
- Clarified that external documentation is secondary during project deconstruction, focusing on understanding the actual code and design.
- No functional or interface changes; core Socratic learning philosophy remains unchanged.

- Added authoritative pre-configured source files for seven key CS/AI domains (frontend, backend, AI infrastructure, agent harness, multi-agent, reinforcement learning, ROS).
- Introduced a Chinese-language README (README.zh-CN.md) and an English README.
- Removed legacy documentation file (skill-card.md).
- Internal domain/source structure now defined in dedicated YAML files under the sources directory.
- No changes made to core logic or user-facing behavior; these are foundational documentation and configuration updates.

Initial release of tech-tutor – an interactive, Socratic learning companion for CS and AI.

- Guides users to genuine understanding using questioning, rather than just giving answers.
- Supports two learning modes: topic exploration and project/codebase deconstruction.
- Adapts to user’s knowledge level, goals, and pace; learning is flexible and user-directed.
- Integrates authoritative sources; seven CS/AI domains have pre-configured references.
- Automatically saves a learning record, with per-user or per-project organization.
